snippet.title: Isle of Reveries: OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
ACTION ADVENTURE ISLE OF REVERIES OUT TODAY ON CONSOLES!
Experience masterful interlinking design within our Forsaken Land…

✨Play Now on Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/isle-of-reveries-switch/?srsltid=AfmBOoqwCrk-QErWkkDsyeXgd1yg3buyzM0rrT1V3rnbK6JaC8U47whj
✨Play Now on PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10020559
✨Play Now on XBOX:  https://www.xbox.com/en-US/auth/msa?action=logIn&returnUrl=%2Fen-US%2Fgames%2Fstore%2Fisle-of-reveries%2F9p80hz476j39&prompt=none
✨Join the Isle of Reveries mailing list for exclusive updates and deals: https://airport.electricairship.com/isle-of-reveries/


Along the adventure, you will encounter atmospheres yet unseen in the twenty-first century! Indeed, Isle of Reveries will transport you back to the schoolbus, where you once experienced forbidden somber on GameBoy Color. 
Follow owlkin Lief as he climbs that forbidden rope heavenward. Amid clouds, voices sing– the floating Isle of Reveries! Its cloying promise, to revive your deceased younger brother…
To prove your worth, you must complete a gauntlet– six dungeons lie in wait, each with mind-melting puzzle mechanics, unique metroidvania tools, and epic combat encounters! Get lost, owl– you may yet find more hiding in the shadows…
You see now, an Epic Adventure SMASHES today, September 4, onto Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC! 

-EXPLORE A VAST OVERWORLD & CONQUER DUNGEONS: Eight different biomes in the overworld. Seven different dungeons, each with unique themes, mechanics, and key items.

-COPY & ECHO OBJECTS: Use Lief's fay friend to duplicate and summon nearly any object onto the Isle. You’ll discover how they interact with your robust set of tools to solve head-scratching puzzles and terrifying combat encounters. 

-FORGE A COMMUNITY: Construct various buildings and forge your downtown! Charming -animal-kin you rescue will move into the settlement, offering even more quests and stories.

Game Details
Title: Isle of Reveries
Release Date: September 4, 2026
Price: $19.99
Platforms: Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 & 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, PC
Publisher: Electric Airship
Developer: desertcucco
Genre: Puzzle action-adventure
Players: single player
Languages: English + more if possible
Press Contact: electricairshipdean@gmail.com 📧
